correctness.rationale: At fixed N, H_S=log N-(log Q)/N with Q=∏ a_i^{a_i}, and H_B=(log N!-log F)/N with F=∏ a_i!. Both are decreasing functions of exact positive integers Q and F, so every comparison can be exact. Integer partitions enumerate every unlabeled positive abundance profile; an independent enumerator and an independent dynamic-programming partition-count calculation agree at N=1,...,8 (counts 1,2,3,5,7,11,15,22). Exhaustive pair comparisons yield zero weak-order disagreements through N=6; at N=7 sole disagreement is (1,1,1,4) vs (2,2,3), Q=(256,432) F=(24,24), so not strict reversal; at N=8 exactly two strict reversed pairs (1,1,1,5)/(2,2,4) with Q=(3125,4096), F=(120,96) and (1,1,6)/(4,4) with Q=(46656,65536), F=(720,576). Checked exact integers, avoiding floating logs. The finite N≤8 search is exhaustive because the domain is bounded and partitions completely describe it.
residual_risks: First strict boundary is exact only for raw indices, unlabeled nonzero integer profiles of fixed total; other index normalizations may alter comparisons.

value.rationale: Brillouin is an important finite-sample alternative to Shannon and often described as close to it; whether finite-count comparisons can reverse ranks is a substantive diagnostic question. The exact first weak mismatch at seven, first strict mismatch at eight, and exhaustive two-pair first strict layer are natural complete classifications useful as methodological and software test cases rather than arbitrary chosen vectors.
residual_risks: Finite N result has no asserted asymptotic frequency, sampling-noise or ecological causation implications.

final_claim: Shannon and Brillouin agree as weak orderings for every integer partition up to N=6; N=7 has one Brillouin tie split by Shannon, and N=8 has exactly two strictly reversed profile pairs.
limitations: Precisely raw Shannon and Brillouin formulas, positive-integer counts, fixed N, unlabeled partitions; not evenness indices or continuous weights.
Potential prior isolated examples in unindexed education material.
